mathematical_review.novelty_status: Classical Sklyanin/THCR descriptions, star-product coefficients, inner-wheel vanishing, a=0 Orlov equivalence, elliptic Torelli and Hesse invariants are attributed. No comprehensive priority determination is claimed.
mathematical_review.current_conclusion: The general existence theorem is retained. For the specified five-variable Hesse-Sklyanin input, the rational equation over K is explicit, and the complete comparison descends to that fixed model over some finite K-prime/K, preserving rotation and the specified cubic period.
not_claimed: Kernel descent to K, a computed extension degree, or uniqueness of the K-form.
An algebraic relative equivalence through h=0, or equivalence of the whole projective categories in dimension three.
Evaluation of the complete Taylor series on arbitrary Laurent-coefficient MF matrices.
An explicit all-order generator-fixing formality map, the scalar A(h), or matrices of an equivalence kernel.
Direct extraction of all low-rotation product matrices from the noncommutative category.
All-order categorical results established by finite symbolic tests.
